import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Check for missing values and handle
print("Handling missing values...")
train_df = train_df.replace([np.nan], -1)
test_df = test_df.replace([np.nan], -1)

# Preprocessing
# Drop Id from train, Target Cover_Type
X_train_full = train_df.drop(columns=["Id", "Cover_Type"])
y_train_full = train_df["Cover_Type"]

# Drop Id from test
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=["Id"])
test_ids = test_df["Id"]

# Feature matrix
feature_names = X_train_full.columns.tolist()

# Subsample training data to manage runtime
n_train_samples = 200000
# Random subsample to ensure representativeness
subsample_idx = np.random.choice(len(X_train_full), n_train_samples, replace=False)
X_train_full = X_train_full.iloc[subsample_idx]
y_train_full = y_train_full.iloc[subsample_idx]

print(f"Subsampled train size: {len(X_train_full)}")

# Split into Train and Validation
# Hold out 20% for validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Get number of classes
num_classes = y_tr.nunique()
print(f"Number of classes: {num_classes}")

# Prepare Model for LightGBM
clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    num_leaves=31,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise=False,
    n_jobs=-1,
    feature_fraction=0.8,
    bagging_fraction=0.8,
)

# Fit Model
print("Training model...")
clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate on Hold-out set
y_val_pred = clf.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)

# Print Validation Metric
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy}")

# Predict on Test Set
print("Predicting on test set...")
y_test_pred = clf.predict(X_test)

# Create Submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})

# Save to ./submission/submission.csv
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
